title: Count the rows
prompt: How many rows (passengers) are in the dataset?

title: List the columns
prompt: Return a list of all column names in the dataset, in their natural order.
hint: `df.columns` is an Index; wrap it in `list(...)`.

title: Select two columns
prompt: Return a DataFrame with only the `Name` and `Age` columns.

title: Female passengers
prompt: Return all rows where `Sex` is `'female'`.

title: Passengers over 30
prompt: Return all passengers whose `Age` is strictly greater than 30.

title: Average age
prompt: What is the mean of the `Age` column?

title: Overall survival rate
prompt: What fraction of passengers survived? `Survived` is 1 for survivors, 0 otherwise.
hint: The mean of a 0/1 column is the proportion of 1s.

title: Count per port
prompt: Count the number of passengers for each `Embarked` port. Return a Series.

title: Survival rate by sex
prompt: Compute the survival rate for each `Sex`. Return a Series indexed by `Sex`.

title: Average fare by class
prompt: Average `Fare` per `Pclass`, sorted by class ascending.

title: Missing values per column
prompt: Return the number of missing (NaN) values per column, as a Series.

title: Missing values as percent
prompt: Return the percentage of missing values per column, rounded to 2 decimals.
hint: `isna().mean()` gives the fraction; multiply by 100 and round.

title: Average age by sex and class
prompt: Compute the average `Age` for each (`Sex`, `Pclass`) pair.
hint: Pass a list of columns to `groupby`.

title: Family size column
prompt: Add a new column `FamilySize` equal to `SibSp + Parch + 1`, and return the resulting DataFrame.

title: Top 5 oldest
prompt: Return the 5 oldest passengers, with only `Name` and `Age` columns, sorted from oldest to youngest.
hint: `nlargest` sorts descending and takes the top N.

title: Top 10 highest fares
prompt: Return the 10 passengers with the highest `Fare`, sorted by `Fare` descending.

title: Survival by family size
prompt: Compute the survival rate grouped by family size, where family size is `SibSp + Parch + 1`.

title: Highest-fare passenger per class
prompt: For each `Pclass`, return the full row of the passenger with the highest `Fare`. Return all original columns.

title: Rank by fare within class
prompt: Add a column `FareRank` ranking passengers by `Fare` within each `Pclass` (highest fare = rank 1; ties share the smallest rank). Return the full DataFrame with the new column.

title: Top 5 surnames
prompt: Compute the 5 most common surnames in the `Name` column (surname is the part before the comma). Return a Series.
